description: Rank currencies by a 0–100 safe-haven score that combines low volatility, shallow drawdown, and 2008-crisis resilience. Use for "which currency holds up in a crisis" questions. Provide `currencies` to score specific codes, or omit to rank the liquid-fiat pool. Precious metals are not supported. Use `analyze_volatility` for pure dispersion and `analyze_drawdown` for peak-to-trough loss. Defaults: window from 2007-01-01 (or 20 years before `to`), `base` USD, `limit` 10. Returns `{ base, from, to, crisis, results[] }`. Returns an error when no rate data is available for the window. Requires a signed-in connection and the Growth plan or higher; each successful call bills 1 API request.

base.description: Base currency to measure against (3-letter ISO 4217). Defaults to USD.

currencies.description: Comma-separated currencies to score, e.g. CHF,JPY. OMIT to rank the liquid-fiat safe-haven pool (precious metals are not supported).

from.description: Window start YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to 2007-01-01 (spans the 2008 crisis + COVID), or to 20 years before `to` when that is later.

to.description: Window end YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to today.

name: analyze_safe_haven
title: Safe-haven analysis
